units.Amos 1:1: The words of Amos that came among nakkarim from Tekoa, which he saw concerning Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
units.Amos 1:2: He said: “The Lord spoke from Zion and gave His voice from Jerusalem; the shepherds’ pastures mourned, and Carmel’s summit dried up.”
units.Amos 1:3: The Lord said: “For three impieties of Damascus, and for four, I will not turn away from him, because they sawed the pregnant women of those in Gilead with iron saws.
units.Amos 1:4: I will send fire into Hazael’s house, and it will devour the foundations of the son of Ader,
units.Amos 1:5: and I will shatter Damascus’s bars and destroy inhabitants from the Plain of On. I will cut down a tribe from the men of Harran, and the people of Syria, called by name, will be taken captive,” says the Lord.
units.Amos 1:6: Thus says the Lord: “For three impieties of Gaza, and for four, I will not turn away from them, because they took Solomon’s captives into captivity, to shut them up in Idumea.
units.Amos 1:7: I will send fire upon Gaza’s walls, and it will devour her foundations.
units.Amos 1:8: I will destroy inhabitants from Azotus, and a tribe will be removed from Ascalon. I will bring My hand against Accaron, and the remaining foreigners will perish,” says the Lord.
units.Amos 1:9: Thus says the Lord: “For three impieties of Tyre, and for four, I will not turn away from her, because they shut Solomon’s captives up in Idumea and did not remember a covenant of brothers.
units.Amos 1:10: I will send fire upon Tyre’s walls, and it will devour her foundations.”
units.Amos 1:11: Thus says the Lord: “For three impieties of Idumea, and for four, I will not turn away from them, because they pursued his brother with a sword; he ravaged a womb upon the earth, seized his shuddering as testimony, and kept his onrush for victory.
units.Amos 1:12: I will send fire into Teman, and it will devour the foundations of her walls.”
units.Amos 1:13: Thus says the Lord: “For three impieties of the sons of Ammon, and for four, I will not turn away from him, because they ripped open the pregnant women of the Gileadites in order to enlarge their borders.
units.Amos 1:14: I will kindle fire upon Rabbah’s walls, and it will devour her foundations with shouting on the day of war; she will be shaken on the day of her end.
units.Amos 1:15: Her kings will go into captivity, their priests and their rulers together,” says the Lord.
units.Amos 2:1: Thus says the Lord: “For three impieties of Moab, and for four, I will not turn away from him, because they burned the bones of Idumea’s king into lime.
units.Amos 2:2: I will send fire upon Moab, and it will devour the foundations of her cities. Moab will die in weakness, with shouting and the sound of a trumpet.
units.Amos 2:3: I will destroy the judge from her, and kill all her rulers with him,” says the Lord.
units.Amos 2:4: Thus says the Lord: “For three impieties of the sons of Judah, and for four, I will not turn away from him, because they rejected the Lord’s law and did not keep His ordinances. Their vain things, which they made, led them astray—the things their fathers followed.
units.Amos 2:5: I will send fire upon Judah, and it will devour Jerusalem’s foundations.”
units.Amos 2:6: Thus says the Lord: “For three impieties of Israel, and for four, I will not turn away from him, because they sold a righteous person for silver and a poor person for sandals,
units.Amos 2:7: which tread upon the earth’s dust. They struck the heads of the poor with their fists and turned aside the way of the humble; a son and his father went in to the same young slave woman, to profane the name of their God,
units.Amos 2:8: and, tying their garments with cords, they made hangings next to the altar, and drank wine from extortions in their God’s house.
units.Amos 2:9: But I removed the Amorite from before them, whose height was like a cedar and who was strong as an oak. I removed his fruit above and his roots below.
units.Amos 2:10: I brought you up from Egypt’s land and led you around in the wilderness forty years, to inherit the Amorites’ land.
units.Amos 2:11: I took some of your sons as prophets and some of your young men for consecration. Are these things not so, sons of Israel?” says the Lord.
units.Amos 2:12: “But you gave the consecrated ones wine to drink and commanded the prophets, saying, ‘You must not prophesy!’
units.Amos 2:13: Therefore look, I roll beneath you as a wagon full of straw rolls,
units.Amos 2:14: and flight will perish from the runner, the mighty one will certainly not maintain his strength, and the fighter will certainly not save his life,
units.Amos 2:15: and the archer will certainly not stand, the swift of foot will certainly not be saved, nor will the horseman save his life,
units.Amos 2:16: and he will find his heart among powers; the naked one will pursue on that day,” says the Lord.
units.Amos 3:1: Hear this word that the Lord spoke against you, house of Israel, and against every tribe I brought up from Egypt’s land, saying:
units.Amos 3:2: “You alone have I known among all the earth’s tribes; therefore I will exact judgment upon you for all your sins.”
units.Amos 3:3: Will two go together at all unless they make themselves known to one another?
units.Amos 3:4: Will a lion roar from its thicket without prey? Will a young lion give its voice from its enclosure at all unless it has seized something?
units.Amos 3:5: Will a bird fall upon the ground without a fowler? Will a trap be sprung upon the ground without catching something?
units.Amos 3:6: Will a trumpet sound in a city and the people not be alarmed? Will there be calamity in a city that the Lord has not done?
units.Amos 3:7: For the Lord God will certainly do no deed unless He reveals His discipline to His servants the prophets.
units.Amos 3:8: A lion will roar—and who will not fear? The Lord God has spoken—and who will not prophesy?
units.Amos 3:9: Announce to the regions among the Assyrians and to Egypt’s regions: “Gather upon Samaria’s mountain and see the many astonishing things in her midst and the oppression within her!”
units.Amos 3:10: “She did not know what would be against her,” says the Lord—those storing injustice and suffering in their regions.
units.Amos 3:11: Therefore thus says the Lord God: “Tyre, your land will be desolated all around; he will bring down your strength from you, and your regions will be plundered.”
units.Amos 3:12: Thus says the Lord: “As when a shepherd snatches two legs or an earlobe from a lion’s mouth, so the sons of Israel who dwell in Samaria will be snatched out, opposite a tribe, and priests in Damascus.”
units.Amos 3:13: “Hear and bear witness to Jacob’s house,” says the Lord God Almighty,
units.Amos 3:14: “because on the day I exact judgment upon Israel for its impieties, I will also exact judgment upon Bethel’s altars. The altar’s horns will be demolished and fall upon the ground,
units.Amos 3:15: and I will confound and strike the colonnaded house along with the summer house. Ivory houses will perish, and many other houses will be added,” says the Lord.
units.Amos 4:1: Hear this word, heifers of Bashan on Samaria’s mountain, who oppress the poor and trample the needy, who say to their masters, “Give to us so that we may drink!”
units.Amos 4:2: The Lord swears by His holy things: “Look, days are coming upon you, and they will take you with weapons; fiery pestilences will throw those with you into cauldrons burning underneath,
units.Amos 4:3: and you will be carried out naked opposite one another and thrown onto Mount Remman,” says the Lord God.
units.Amos 4:4: “You entered Bethel and acted lawlessly; at Gilgal you multiplied impiety. You brought your sacrifices for the morning and your tithes for the three-day period,
units.Amos 4:5: and they read a law outside and invoked acknowledgments. Announce that the sons of Israel loved these things,” says the Lord God.
units.Amos 4:6: “I will give you aching teeth in all your cities and shortage of bread in all your places; yet you did not turn to Me,” says the Lord.
units.Amos 4:7: “I withheld rainfall from you three months before the vintage. I will rain on one city but not on another; one portion will be watered, and the portion on which I do not rain will dry up,
units.Amos 4:8: and two or three cities will assemble at one city to drink water, yet they certainly will not be filled; and you did not turn to Me,” says the Lord.
units.Amos 4:9: “I struck you with burning and jaundice. You multiplied your gardens; the caterpillar devoured your vineyards, fig orchards and olive groves, yet not even so did you turn to Me,” says the Lord.
units.Amos 4:10: “I sent death among you on Egypt’s road and killed your young men with the sword, along with the captivity of your horses. I brought your camps up in fire in My anger; yet not even so did you turn to Me,” says the Lord.
units.Amos 4:11: “I overthrew you as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you became like a firebrand snatched from fire. Yet not even so did you turn to Me,” says the Lord.
units.Amos 4:12: “Therefore this is what I will do to you, Israel. Since I will do this to you, prepare to call upon your God, Israel!”
units.Amos 4:13: For look, I am the One establishing thunder and creating wind, announcing His anointed to human beings, making dawn and mist, and stepping upon the earth’s heights. The Lord God Almighty is His name.
units.Amos 5:1: Hear this word of the Lord that I take up over you as a lament, house of Israel:
units.Amos 5:2: “Virgin Israel has fallen; she will certainly not rise again. She stumbled upon her land; no one will raise her.”
units.Amos 5:3: For thus says the Lord, the Lord: “From the city out of which a thousand went, a hundred will remain, and from the one out of which a hundred went, ten will remain for Israel’s house.”
units.Amos 5:4: For thus says the Lord to Israel’s house: “Seek Me and you will live!
units.Amos 5:5: Do not seek Bethel, do not enter Gilgal, and do not cross over to the Well of the Oath; for Gilgal will certainly be taken captive, and Bethel will be as though it did not exist.”
units.Amos 5:6: Seek the Lord and live, so that Joseph’s house does not flare up like fire; it will devour him, and there will be no one to quench it for Israel’s house.
units.Amos 5:7: The Lord makes judgment on high and has placed righteousness upon the earth,
units.Amos 5:8: making all things and refashioning them, turning death’s shadow into morning and darkening day into night; He calls for the sea’s water and pours it upon the earth’s surface. The Lord God Almighty is His name,
units.Amos 5:9: the One distributing shattering against strength and bringing suffering upon a fortress.
units.Amos 5:10: They hated one who reproved at the gates and abhorred a holy word.
units.Amos 5:11: Therefore, because you struck the poor with fists and accepted choice gifts from them, you built houses of polished stone but certainly will not inhabit them; you planted desirable vineyards but certainly will not drink their wine.
units.Amos 5:12: For I knew your many impieties, and your sins are strong: trampling the righteous, taking payments and turning aside the poor at the gates.
units.Amos 5:13: Therefore the understanding person will be silent at that time, because it is an evil time.
units.Amos 5:14: Seek the good and not the evil, so that you may live; then the Lord God Almighty will be with you, just as you said,
units.Amos 5:15: “We have hated evil things and loved good things.” Restore judgment at the gates, so that the Lord God Almighty may have mercy on Joseph’s remaining ones.
units.Amos 5:16: Therefore thus says the Lord God Almighty: “In every square there will be mourning, and in every road it will be said, ‘Alas, alas!’ A farmer will be called to mourning and lamentation and to those skilled in wailing,
units.Amos 5:17: and in every road there will be mourning, because I will pass through your midst,” said the Lord.
units.Amos 5:18: Woe to those desiring the Lord’s day! Why is this Lord’s day for you? It is darkness, not light,
units.Amos 5:19: as when someone flees from a lion and a bear falls upon him, then leaps into his house, braces his hands upon the wall, and a snake bites him.
units.Amos 5:20: Is not the Lord’s day darkness rather than light, gloom that has no brightness in it?
units.Amos 5:21: “I have hated and rejected your festivals, and I certainly will not smell a pleasing scent in your festal gatherings,
units.Amos 5:22: because even if you bring Me whole burnt offerings and your sacrifices, I will not receive them, and I will not look upon the salvation offering of your display.
units.Amos 5:23: Remove from Me the sound of your songs; I will not listen to the music of your instruments,
units.Amos 5:24: and judgment shall roll as water, and righteousness as an impassable torrent.
units.Amos 5:25: Did you offer Me slaughtered offerings and sacrifices in the wilderness for forty years, house of Israel?
units.Amos 5:26: You took up the tent of Moloch and the star of your god Raiphan, their figures that you made for yourselves.
units.Amos 5:27: I will deport you beyond Damascus,” says the Lord; God Almighty is His name.
units.Amos 6:1: Woe to those who despise Zion and trust in Samaria’s mountain! They harvested the firstfruits of nations and entered themselves. House of Israel,
units.Amos 6:2: all of you cross over and see; pass from there to Emath Rabba, and go down from there to Geth of foreigners, the strongest of all these kingdoms, to see whether their borders are greater than your borders.
units.Amos 6:3: You come toward an evil day, drawing near and touching false sabbaths,
units.Amos 6:4: sleeping upon ivory beds and indulging upon your couches, eating young goats from the flocks and milk-fed calves from the herds,
units.Amos 6:5: clapping to the sound of instruments; they reckoned them as lasting, not passing away,
units.Amos 6:6: drinking strained wine and anointing yourselves with the finest perfumes, yet suffering nothing over Joseph’s shattering.
units.Amos 6:7: Therefore now they will be captives from the foremost of the powerful, and horses’ neighing will be removed from Ephraim.
units.Amos 6:8: For the Lord swore by Himself: “I abhor all Jacob’s arrogance and have hated his regions; I will remove the city with all who inhabit it.”
units.Amos 6:9: If ten men remain in one house, they will die, and those left over will remain.
units.Amos 6:10: Their relatives will take them and force their way to bring their bones out of the house. He will say to those in charge of the house, “Is there anyone else with you?” He will say, “No more.” Then he will say, “Be silent, so as not to name the Lord’s name.”
units.Amos 6:11: For look, the Lord commands, and He will strike the great house with fractures and the small house with cracks.
units.Amos 6:12: Will horses pursue upon rocks? Will they remain silent among females? For you turned judgment into anger and the fruit of righteousness into bitterness,
units.Amos 6:13: rejoicing over nothing, saying, “Did we not acquire horns by our own strength?”
units.Amos 6:14: “For look, I am raising a nation against you, house of Israel, and they will crush you so that you cannot enter Emath, as far as the Wadi of the West.”
units.Amos 7:1: The Lord showed me this: Look, a brood of locusts was coming at dawn, and look, one bruchus locust, Gog the king.
units.Amos 7:2: When it finishes devouring the land’s grass, I said, “Lord, Lord, be merciful! Who will raise Jacob? He is so few!
units.Amos 7:3: Relent, Lord, concerning this.” “This will not happen,” says the Lord.
units.Amos 7:4: The Lord showed me this: Look, the Lord called for judgment by fire; it devoured the great abyss and devoured the portion.
units.Amos 7:5: I said, “Lord, Lord, cease, please! Who will raise Jacob? He is so few!
units.Amos 7:6: Relent, Lord, concerning this.” “This certainly will not happen,” says the Lord.
units.Amos 7:7: The Lord showed me this: Look, a man was standing upon an adamant wall, with adamant in his hand.
units.Amos 7:8: The Lord said to me, “What do you see, Amos?” I said, “Adamant.” The Lord said to me, “Look, I am setting adamant in the midst of My people Israel. I will certainly no longer pass them by,
units.Amos 7:9: and the altars of laughter will disappear, and Israel’s rites will be laid waste. I will rise against Jeroboam’s house with a sword.”
units.Amos 7:10: Amaziah, priest of Bethel, sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, “Amos is forming conspiracies against you in the midst of Israel’s house. The land certainly cannot endure all his words,
units.Amos 7:11: because Amos says, ‘Jeroboam will die by a sword, and Israel will be led captive away from its land.’”
units.Amos 7:12: Amaziah said to Amos, “Seer, go! Withdraw to Judah’s land; make your living there, and there you will prophesy.
units.Amos 7:13: But you must never again prophesy at Bethel, because it is a king’s sanctuary and a house of kingship.”
units.Amos 7:14: Amos answered Amaziah, “I was no prophet or prophet’s son, but a goat herder and one who scratches sycamore figs,
units.Amos 7:15: and the Lord took me from the sheep, and the Lord said to me, ‘Go, prophesy to My people Israel.’
units.Amos 7:16: Now hear the Lord’s word: You say, ‘Do not prophesy against Israel, and you must not stir up a crowd against Jacob’s house.’
units.Amos 7:17: Therefore thus says the Lord: ‘Your wife will practice prostitution in the city, your sons and daughters will fall by a sword, and your land will be measured out with a cord. You will die in an unclean land, and Israel will be led captive away from its land.’”
units.Amos 8:1: The Lord showed me this: Look, a fowler’s vessel.
units.Amos 8:2: He said, “What do you see, Amos?” I said, “A fowler’s vessel.” The Lord said to me, “The end has arrived upon My people Israel. I will certainly no longer pass them by.
units.Amos 8:3: The temple’s coffered ceilings will wail. On that day,” says the Lord, “many have fallen in every place. I will cast silence upon them.”
units.Amos 8:4: Hear these things now, you who wear out the needy until morning and oppress the poor out of the land,
units.Amos 8:5: saying, “When will the month pass, so we may trade, and the sabbaths, so we may open storehouses, making the measure small and the weights great and making an unjust balance,
units.Amos 8:6: to acquire the poor with silver and a lowly person in exchange for sandals? And we will trade from every kind of produce.”
units.Amos 8:7: The Lord swears by Jacob’s arrogance: “He will never forget all your works.”
units.Amos 8:8: Will the earth not be disturbed over these things, and everyone dwelling in it mourn? A consummation will rise like a river and descend like Egypt’s river.
units.Amos 8:9: “On that day,” says the Lord God, “the sun will set at midday, and the light will grow dark upon the earth in daytime.
units.Amos 8:10: I will turn your festivals to mourning and all your songs to lamentation. I will put sackcloth on every waist and baldness on every head; I will make him like mourning for a beloved one, and those with him like a day of pain.
units.Amos 8:11: Look, days are coming,” says the Lord, “when I will send famine upon the earth: not famine for bread or thirst for water, but famine for hearing the Lord’s word.
units.Amos 8:12: Waters will be shaken as far as the sea, and from north to east they will run about seeking the Lord’s word, but certainly will not find it.
units.Amos 8:13: On that day the beautiful virgins and the young men will faint from thirst,
units.Amos 8:14: those who swear by Samaria’s propitiation and say, ‘Your god lives, Dan!’ and ‘Your god lives, Beersheba!’ They will fall and certainly never rise again.”
units.Amos 9:1: I saw the Lord standing upon the altar. He said, “Strike the atonement cover, and the foregates will shake; cut through the heads of all. I will kill their survivors with a sword. No one fleeing from among them will escape, and no one seeking safety will be saved.
units.Amos 9:2: If they burrow into Hades, My hand will pull them up from there; if they climb to heaven, I will bring them down from there.
units.Amos 9:3: If they hide on Carmel’s summit, I will search them out and take them from there. If they plunge from My eyes into the sea’s depths, I will command the dragon there, and it will bite them.
units.Amos 9:4: If they go into captivity before their enemies, I will command the sword there, and it will kill them. I will fix My eyes upon them for evils and not for good things.”
units.Amos 9:5: The Lord, Lord God Almighty, touches the earth and shakes it; all who dwell in it will mourn. Its consummation will rise like a river and descend like Egypt’s river.
units.Amos 9:6: He builds His ascent into heaven and establishes His promise upon the earth; He calls for the sea’s water and pours it upon the earth’s surface. The Lord God Almighty is His name.
units.Amos 9:7: “Are you not like the children of Ethiopians to Me, children of Israel?” says the Lord. “Did I not bring Israel up from Egypt’s land, the foreigners from Cappadocia and the Syrians from a pit?
units.Amos 9:8: Look, the Lord God’s eyes are upon the kingdom of sinners, and I will remove it from the earth’s surface. Yet I will not completely remove Jacob’s house,” says the Lord.
units.Amos 9:9: “For look, I am giving a command: I will winnow Israel’s house among all the nations as one winnows in a winnowing basket, and no fragment will fall to the ground.
units.Amos 9:10: All the sinners of My people will die by a sword, those who say, ‘Evils certainly will not draw near or come upon us.’
units.Amos 9:11: On that day I will raise David’s fallen tent; I will rebuild its fallen parts, raise its demolished parts and rebuild it as in days of old,
units.Amos 9:12: so that the remaining human beings and all the nations over whom My name is called may seek,” says the Lord God, who does these things.
units.Amos 9:13: “Look, days are coming,” says the Lord, “when threshing will overtake the vintage and grapes will darken to ripeness at seedtime. The mountains will drip sweetness, and all the hills will be planted together.
units.Amos 9:14: I will reverse the captivity of My people Israel. They will build ruined cities and inhabit them, plant vineyards and drink their wine, plant gardens and eat their fruit.
units.Amos 9:15: I will plant them upon their land, and they will certainly never again be uprooted from the land I have given them,” says the Lord God Almighty.
units.Zechariah 14:1: Look, days of the Lord are coming, and your spoils will be divided within you.
units.Zechariah 14:2: I will gather all the nations against Jerusalem for war. The city will be captured, the houses plundered and the women violated. Half the city will go into captivity, but the remnant of My people will certainly not be destroyed from the city.
units.Zechariah 14:3: The Lord will go out and draw up for battle among those nations, as on the day of His battle formation on a day of war.
units.Zechariah 14:4: On that day His feet will stand on the Mount of Olives opposite Jerusalem to the east. The Mount of Olives will split, half of it toward the east and half toward the sea—a very great chasm; half the mountain will incline north and half south.
units.Zechariah 14:5: The ravine of My mountains will be blocked; the mountain ravine will be joined as far as Iasol and blocked as it was blocked in the days of the earthquake, in the days of Oziah king of Judah. The Lord my God will come, and all the holy ones with Him.
units.Zechariah 14:6: On that day there will be no light, cold or ice.
units.Zechariah 14:7: It will last one day, and that day is known to the Lord, neither day nor night; toward evening there will be light.
units.Zechariah 14:8: On that day living water will go out from Jerusalem, half into the first sea and half into the last sea; it will be so in summer and spring.
units.Zechariah 14:9: The Lord will be king over all the earth. On that day the Lord will be one, and His name one,
units.Joel 4:1: “For look, in those days and at that time, when I turn back the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,
units.Joel 4:2: I will gather all the nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. There I will enter into judgment with them over My people and My inheritance Israel, who were scattered among the nations; and they divided up My land
units.Joel 4:3: and cast lots over My people; they gave the boys to prostitutes and sold the girls for wine, which they drank.
units.Joel 4:4: What have you to do with Me, Tyre and Sidon and all Galilee of foreigners? Are you repaying Me a recompense? Or do you bear a sharp grudge against Me? I will speedily repay your recompense upon your heads,
units.Joel 4:5: because you took My silver and gold and brought My chosen and beautiful things into your temples,
units.Joel 4:6: and sold the sons of Judah and the sons of Jerusalem to the sons of the Greeks, so as to thrust them out of their own borders.
units.Joel 4:7: Look, I am rousing them from the place to which you sold them, and I will repay your recompense upon your heads,
units.Joel 4:8: and I will sell your sons and daughters into the hands of the sons of Judah, and they will sell them into captivity to a nation far away, because the Lord has spoken.”
units.Joel 4:9: Proclaim these things among the nations: Consecrate war! Rouse the fighters! Draw near and come up, all soldiers!
units.Joel 4:10: Beat your plows into swords and your sickles into lances; let the powerless say, “I am strong!”
units.Joel 4:11: Assemble and enter, all surrounding nations, and gather there! Let the meek become a fighter!
units.Joel 4:12: Let all the nations be roused and come up to the Valley of Jehoshaphat, because there I will sit to judge all the surrounding nations.
units.Joel 4:13: Send out sickles, because the vintage is at hand! Enter and tread, because the winepress is full; the vats overflow, because their evils have multiplied.
units.Joel 4:14: Sounds rang out in the Valley of Judgment, because the Lord’s day is near in the Valley of Judgment.
units.Joel 4:15: The sun and moon will grow dark, and the stars will sink their brightness.
units.Joel 4:16: The Lord will cry out from Zion and give His voice from Jerusalem; heaven and earth will shake. But the Lord will spare His people, and the Lord will strengthen the sons of Israel.
units.Joel 4:17: You will recognize that I am the Lord your God, dwelling in Zion on My holy mountain. Jerusalem will be a holy city, and foreigners will no longer pass through her.
units.Joel 4:18: On that day mountains will drip sweetness, hills will flow with milk, and all Judah’s water outlets will flow with water. A spring will come out of the Lord’s house and water the Wadi of Rushes.
units.Joel 4:19: Egypt will become desolate, and Idumea a desolate plain, because of injustices concerning the sons of Judah, because they poured out righteous blood in their land.
units.Joel 4:20: But Judea will be inhabited forever, and Jerusalem for generations upon generations.
units.Joel 4:21: “I will avenge their blood, and I will certainly not acquit.” And the Lord will dwell in Zion.
units.2 Kings 8:7: Elisha came to Damascus, and the son of Ader, king of Syria, was ill. They reported to him, saying, ‘The man of God has come here.’
units.2 Kings 8:8: The king said to Hazael, ‘Take a manaa in your hand and go to meet the man of God. Inquire of the Lord through him, saying, Will I recover from this illness of mine?’
units.2 Kings 8:9: Hazael went to meet him, taking a manaa in his hand and all the good things of Damascus, a load for forty camels. He came and stood before him and said to Elisha, ‘Your son, the son of Ader, king of Syria, sent me to you, saying, Will I recover from this illness of mine?’
units.2 Kings 8:10: Elisha said, ‘Go, tell him: You will surely live. And the Lord has shown me that you will surely die.’
units.2 Kings 8:11: He stood before his face and held it until shame, and the man of God wept.
units.2 Kings 8:12: Hazael said, ‘Why does my lord weep?’ He said, ‘Because I know all the evils you will do to the sons of Israel: you will send their strongholds into fire, kill their chosen men with the sword, dash down their infants, and tear open their pregnant women.’
units.2 Kings 8:13: Hazael said, ‘Who is your slave, a dead dog, that he should do this thing?’ Elisha said, ‘The Lord has shown me you reigning over Syria.’
units.2 Kings 8:14: He went away from Elisha and entered his master’s presence. He said to him, ‘What did Elisha say to you?’ He said, ‘He told me, You will surely live.’
units.2 Kings 8:15: The next day he took the machma, dipped it in the water, and wrapped it over his face. He died, and Hazael became king in his place.
units.Jeremiah 30:29: For Damascus: Hamath and Arpad were ashamed because they heard an evil report. They were distraught and angry; they certainly cannot rest.
units.Jeremiah 30:30: Damascus grew feeble and turned to flight; trembling seized her.
units.Jeremiah 30:31: How did he not abandon My city? They loved a village.
units.Jeremiah 30:32: Therefore young men will fall in your squares, and all your warriors will fall, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 30:33: I will kindle fire in Damascus’s wall, and it will devour the quarters of Ader’s son.
units.Isaiah 17:1: The utterance against Damascus. Behold, Damascus will be removed from the cities and become a ruin,
units.Isaiah 17:2: abandoned for everlasting time, a bed and resting place for flocks, with no one pursuing.
units.Isaiah 17:3: There will no longer be a stronghold for Ephraim to flee to, nor a kingdom in Damascus, and the Syrians’ remainder will perish; for you are no better than Israel’s sons and their glory. Thus says the Lord Sabaoth.
units.Isaiah 17:4: On that day Jacob’s glory will fail, and the fat parts of his glory will be shaken.
units.Isaiah 17:5: It will be as when someone gathers a standing harvest and reaps seed from the ears in his arm, as when someone gathers an ear in a firm ravine,
units.Isaiah 17:6: and a stalk is left in it, or like olive berries, two or three on a lofty top, or four or five left on their branches. Thus says the Lord, Israel’s God.
units.Zephaniah 2:1: Gather and bind yourselves together, O undisciplined nation,
units.Zephaniah 2:2: before you become like a passing flower, before the Lord’s wrath comes upon you, before the day of the Lord’s fury comes upon you.
units.Zephaniah 2:3: Seek the Lord, all the humble of the earth; practice judgment, seek righteousness and answer these things, so that you may be sheltered on the day of the Lord’s wrath.
units.Zephaniah 2:4: For Gaza will be plundered and Ashkelon will disappear; Ashdod will be cast out at midday and Ekron uprooted.
units.Zephaniah 2:5: Woe to the seacoast’s inhabitants, sojourners of Cretans! The Lord’s word is against you, Canaan, land of foreigners: I will destroy you from your dwelling.
units.Zephaniah 2:6: Crete will become pasture for flocks and an enclosure for sheep,
units.Zephaniah 2:7: and the seacoast will belong to the remnant of Judah’s house. They will graze upon them in Ashkelon’s houses; at evening they will lodge away from the sons of Judah, for the Lord their God has visited them and turned their captivity.
units.Zechariah 9:1: An oracle of the Lord’s word: in Sedrach’s land and Damascus is His sacrifice, because the Lord watches human beings and all Israel’s tribes,
units.Zechariah 9:2: and Emath within its borders, Tyre and Sidon, because they were exceedingly wise.
units.Zechariah 9:3: Tyre built herself fortifications, stored silver like dust and gathered gold like the mud of the roads.
units.Zechariah 9:4: Therefore the Lord will inherit her and strike her strength into the sea; she will be consumed by fire.
units.Zechariah 9:5: Ashkelon will see and fear; Gaza will suffer greatly, and Akkaron too, because she was ashamed at her downfall. A king will perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon will certainly not be inhabited.
units.Zechariah 9:6: Foreigners will dwell in Azotus, and I will bring down the foreigners’ arrogance.
units.Zechariah 9:7: I will remove their blood from their mouth and their detestable things from between their teeth. This one too will remain for our God; they will be like a commander of a thousand in Judah, and Akkaron like the Jebusite.
units.Zechariah 9:8: I will take a stand for My house to prevent passing through or returning. No one driving them out will come upon them again, for now I have seen with My own eyes.
units.Obadiah 1:1: The vision of Obadiah. Thus says the Lord God to Idumea: I heard a report from the Lord, and He sent a dispatch to the nations: “Rise up! Let us rise against her for battle!”
units.Obadiah 1:2: Look, I have made you insignificant among the nations; you are greatly dishonored.
units.Obadiah 1:3: The pride of your heart has lifted you up, you who camp in holes in the rocks, raising his dwelling high and saying in his heart, “Who will bring me down to the ground?”
units.Obadiah 1:4: If you soar like an eagle, and if you place your nest among the stars, from there I will bring you down, says the Lord.
units.Obadiah 1:5: If thieves came in to you, or robbers by night, where would you have been cast away? Would they not have stolen enough for themselves? And if grape gatherers came in to you, would they not have left a gleaning?
units.Obadiah 1:6: How Esau has been searched out, and his hidden things seized!
units.Obadiah 1:7: All the men of your covenant sent you out as far as your borders; the men at peace with you opposed you and prevailed over you. They set ambushes beneath you. There is no understanding in them.
units.Obadiah 1:8: On that day, says the Lord, I will destroy the wise from Idumea and understanding from Mount Esau.
units.Obadiah 1:9: Your warriors from Teman will be terrified, so that a person may be removed from Mount Esau,
units.Obadiah 1:10: because of the slaughter and the impiety toward your brother Jacob; and shame will cover you, and you will be removed forever.
units.Obadiah 1:11: From the day you stood opposed, on the day foreigners took his strength captive and strangers entered his gates and cast lots over Jerusalem, you too were like one of them.
units.Obadiah 1:12: Do not look on your brother’s day, on the day of strangers; do not rejoice over the sons of Judah on the day of their destruction; do not speak boastfully on the day of affliction.
units.Obadiah 1:13: Do not enter the gates of peoples on the day of their suffering. You, too, must not look on their assembly on the day of their destruction, and do not join in attacking their strength on the day of their destruction.
units.Obadiah 1:14: Do not stand at their escape routes to destroy those of them who are being saved, and do not shut in those fleeing from them on the day of affliction.
units.Obadiah 1:15: For the day of the Lord is near against all the nations. Just as you acted, so it will be for you; your recompense will be repaid upon your own head.
units.Jeremiah 30:1: For Idumea, thus says the Lord: There is no longer wisdom in Teman; counsel perished from the discerning; their wisdom went away.
units.Jeremiah 30:2: Their place was deceived. Go deep to dwell, inhabitants of Dedan, for he did difficult things; I brought them upon him at the time I visited him.
units.Jeremiah 30:3: For grape gatherers came to you; they will leave you no remnants. Like thieves by night they will lay their hand upon you.
units.Jeremiah 30:4: For I dragged Esau away and uncovered their secrets; they certainly cannot hide. They perished by the hand of his brother and his neighbor, and it is not possible
units.Jeremiah 30:5: for your orphan to remain so that he may live. And I will live, and widows have trusted in Me.
units.Jeremiah 30:6: For thus said the Lord: Those for whom there was no law to drink the cup drank it. And you, though acquitted, certainly will not be acquitted, for you will certainly drink.
units.Jeremiah 30:7: For I swore by Myself, says the Lord, that you will become an untrodden place, a reproach, and a curse in her midst, and all her cities will be deserted for ever.
units.Jeremiah 30:8: I heard a report from the Lord, and He sent messengers to the nations: Gather and come against her; rise for war!
units.Jeremiah 30:9: I made you small among nations, easily despised among people.
units.Jeremiah 30:10: Your playfulness assailed you; your heart’s insolence destroyed holes in rocks and seized the strength of a high hill. For he raised his nest like an eagle; from there I will bring you down.
units.Jeremiah 30:11: Idumea will become an untrodden place; everyone passing by her will hiss.
units.Jeremiah 30:12: As Sodom, Gomorrah, and her neighboring places were overturned, said the Lord Almighty, no person will settle there, and no human being will live there.
units.Jeremiah 30:13: Like a lion he will come up from Jordan’s midst into Aitham’s place, for I will quickly drive them away from her. Appoint the young men over her. For who is like Me? Who will resist Me, and what shepherd can stand before Me?
units.Jeremiah 30:14: Therefore hear the Lord’s counsel that He planned against Idumea and His purpose against Teman’s inhabitants: Surely the smallest sheep will be swept together; surely their dwelling will be made untrodden over her.
units.Jeremiah 30:15: For at the sound of their fall the earth shook, and your cry was heard at the sea.
units.Jeremiah 30:16: Like an eagle he will look and stretch his wings over her fortifications. That day Idumea’s strong men’s hearts will be like the heart of a woman in labor.
units.Jeremiah 30:17: For Ammon’s sons, thus said the Lord: Are there no sons in Israel, or have they no one to inherit? Why did Melchom take Gad, and will their people live in their cities?
units.Jeremiah 30:18: Therefore days are coming, says the Lord, when I will make the din of wars heard against Rabbath. They will become an untrodden place and a destruction, her altars will be burned with fire, and Israel will receive his rule.
units.Jeremiah 30:19: Shout aloud, Heshbon, for Gai perished! Cry out, daughters of Rabbath; put on sackcloth, be seized with distress, and beat yourselves over Melchom, for he will go into deportation, his priests and rulers together.
units.Jeremiah 30:20: Why do you exult in the plains of the Anakim, daughter of dishonor, trusting in her treasures and saying, Who will come against me?
units.Jeremiah 30:21: I am bringing fear upon you, said the Lord, from all your surroundings. You will be scattered, each straight ahead, and there will be no one gathering.
units.2 Kings 15:13: Sellum son of Jabis became king. In the thirty-ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Sellum reigned a month of days in Samaria.
units.2 Kings 15:14: Manaem son of Gaddi went up from Tharsila, came to Samaria, struck Sellum son of Jabis in Samaria, and put him to death.
units.2 Kings 15:15: The rest of Sellum’s deeds and the conspiracy he formed—behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
units.2 Kings 15:16: Then Manaem struck Thersa, everything in it, and its territory from Thersa, because they did not open to him. He struck it and ripped open the pregnant women.
units.2 Kings 23:15: Moreover, he tore down the altar at Bethel, the high place Jeroboam son of Nabat had made, who caused Israel to sin—both that altar and the high place. He shattered its stones, reduced it to dust, and burned the grove.
units.2 Kings 23:16: Josiah turned aside and saw the tombs there in the city. He sent and took the bones from the tombs, burned them on the altar, and defiled it, according to the Lord’s word which the man of God spoke while Jeroboam stood at the festival beside the altar. Turning, he lifted his eyes toward the tomb of the man of God who had spoken these words.
units.2 Kings 23:17: He said, ‘What is that rocky marker I see?’ The city’s men told him, ‘It is the man of God who came out of Judah and proclaimed these words which he proclaimed against Bethel’s altar.’
units.2 Kings 23:18: He said, ‘Leave it alone. Let no one move his bones.’ His bones were spared together with the bones of the prophet who came from Samaria.
units.2 Kings 17:7: This happened because the Israelites sinned against the Lord their God, who brought them up from Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and they feared other gods.
units.2 Kings 17:8: They walked in the ordinances of the nations whom the Lord removed before the Israelites; and Israel’s kings, all who acted so,
units.2 Kings 17:9: and all the Israelites who clothed themselves in words that were not so against the Lord their God, built themselves high places in all their cities, from watchtower to fortified city.
units.2 Kings 17:10: They set up pillars and groves for themselves on every high hill and under every leafy tree.
units.2 Kings 17:11: They burned incense there at all the high places like the nations whom the Lord deported before them. They made associates and engraved, to provoke the Lord.
units.2 Kings 17:12: They served the idols, concerning which the Lord had said to them, ‘You shall not do this thing to the Lord.’
units.2 Kings 17:13: The Lord warned Israel and Judah through all His prophets, every seer: ‘Turn from your evil ways and keep My commandments, My ordinances, and all the law I commanded your fathers, all that I sent to them through My servants the prophets.’
units.2 Kings 17:14: But they did not listen. They hardened their back more than the back of their fathers.
units.2 Kings 17:15: They did not keep His testimonies by which He warned them. They followed vain things and became vain, and followed the nations around them, concerning whom He had commanded them not to do such things.
units.2 Kings 17:16: They abandoned the commandments of the Lord their God. They made a casting for themselves, two heifers, made groves, bowed down to all heaven’s host, and served Baal.
units.2 Kings 17:17: They led their sons and daughters through fire, practiced divinations, read omens, and were sold to do evil in the Lord’s eyes, provoking Him.
units.2 Kings 17:18: The Lord was very angry with Israel and removed them from His presence. None remained except the tribe of Judah alone.
units.Jeremiah 17:24: And if you truly listen to Me, says the Lord, not bringing burdens through this city’s gates on the Sabbath day and consecrating the Sabbath day by doing no work,
units.Jeremiah 17:25: then kings and rulers sitting on David’s throne will enter through this city’s gates, mounted on their chariots and horses, they and their rulers, Judah’s men and those dwelling in Jerusalem; and this city will be inhabited for ever.
units.Jeremiah 17:26: And they will come from Judah’s cities, around Jerusalem, Benjamin’s land, the plain, the mountain and the south, bringing whole burnt offerings, sacrifice, incense offerings, grain offering and frankincense, bringing praise into the Lord’s house.
units.Jeremiah 17:27: And if you do not listen to Me to consecrate the Sabbath day, not lifting burdens and not entering Jerusalem’s gates on the Sabbath day, I will kindle fire in her gates, and it will devour Jerusalem’s quarters and not be extinguished.
units.Isaiah 10:1: Woe to those writing wickedness! For when they write, they write wickedness,
units.Isaiah 10:2: turning aside the judgment of the poor, seizing the justice of My people’s needy, so that a widow becomes their prey and an orphan their plunder.
units.Isaiah 10:3: What will they do on the day of visitation? For affliction will come to you from far away. To whom will you flee for help, and where will you leave your glory,
units.Isaiah 10:4: so as not to fall into captivity? For all these things the anger did not turn away, but the hand is still high.
units.Malachi 1:6: “A son honors his father, and a slave his master. If I am a father, where is My honor? If I am a master, where is the fear of Me?” says the Lord Almighty. You priests who belittle My name! But you said, “How have we belittled Thy name?”
units.Malachi 1:7: “By bringing polluted loaves to My altar.” But you said, “How have we polluted them?” “By your saying, ‘The Lord’s table is despised, and the foods placed upon it are despised.’”
units.Malachi 1:8: “For if you bring a blind animal for sacrifice, is that not evil? If you bring one that is lame or sick, is that not evil? Bring it, then, to your ruler! Will he accept it? Will he show you favor?” says the Lord Almighty.
units.Malachi 1:9: “And now appease the face of your God and plead with Him. These things have happened in your hands. Will I show favor to any of you?” says the Lord Almighty.
units.Malachi 1:10: “For even among you doors will be shut, and you will not kindle My altar for nothing. I have no desire for you,” says the Lord Almighty, “and I will not accept a sacrifice from your hands.”
units.Malachi 1:11: “For from the sun’s rising to its setting, My name has been glorified among the nations, and in every place incense is brought to My name, together with a pure sacrifice, because My name is great among the nations,” says the Lord Almighty.
units.Malachi 1:12: “But you profane it by your saying, ‘The Lord’s table is polluted, and the foods placed upon it are despised.’
units.Malachi 1:13: “And you said, ‘These things are from hardship,’ and I blew them away,” says the Lord Almighty. “You were bringing things seized by force, the lame and the afflicted. If you bring the sacrifice, shall I accept these things from your hands?” says the Lord Almighty.
units.Malachi 1:14: “Cursed is one who was able, and had a male in his flock and a vow concerning it, yet sacrifices a damaged animal to the Lord. For I am a great King,” says the Lord Almighty, “and My name is manifest among the nations.”
units.Job 18:2: “How long before you stop? Hold back, so that we ourselves may speak.
units.Job 18:3: Why have we been silent before you like four-footed animals?
units.Job 18:4: Wrath has dealt with you. What then? If you die, will the world beneath heaven be uninhabited, or will mountains be overturned from their foundations?
units.Job 18:12: An extraordinary fall has been prepared for him.
units.Job 18:13: May the branches of his feet be devoured; death will devour his beautiful things.
units.Job 18:14: May healing burst away from his dwelling, and may distress hold him on a royal charge.
units.Job 18:15: It will lodge in his tent during his night; his splendid things will be strewn with sulfur.
units.Job 18:16: Below, his roots will dry up; above, his harvest will fall.
units.Job 18:17: May his memorial perish from the earth, yet he has a name on the outer face of the land.
units.Job 18:18: May he thrust him from light into darkness.
units.Job 18:19: He will not be recognized among his people, nor will his house be preserved beneath heaven, but others will live in what was his.
units.Job 18:20: Those who came last groaned over him, and astonishment seized those who came first.
units.Job 18:21: These are the houses of the unjust, and this is the place of those who do not know the Lord.”
units.Deuteronomy 8:1: All the commandments which I command you this day you shall take heed to do, that you may live and multiply, and enter and inherit the land which the Lord your God sware unto your fathers.
units.Deuteronomy 8:2: And you shall remember all the way wherein the Lord your God led you in the wilderness, to afflict you and to test you, that the things in your heart might be known, whether you would keep His commandments or not.
units.Deuteronomy 8:3: And He afflicted you, and made you hunger, and fed you with manna, which your fathers did not know, that He might declare unto you that man shall not live by bread alone, but man shall live by every word that proceeds through the mouth of God.
units.Deuteronomy 8:4: Your garments did not wear out upon you, neither did your feet become calloused; behold, these forty years.
units.Deuteronomy 8:5: And you shall know in your heart that, as a man chastens his son, so shall the Lord your God chasten you.
units.Deuteronomy 8:6: And you shall keep the commandments of the Lord your God, to walk in His ways and to fear Him.
units.Deuteronomy 8:7: For the Lord your God brings you into a good and spacious land, where are torrents of water and springs of the depths, flowing through the plains and through the hills;
units.Deuteronomy 8:8: a land of wheat and barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates, a land of olive oil and honey,
units.Deuteronomy 8:9: a land wherein you shall eat your bread without poverty, and shall lack nothing; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you shall mine copper.
units.Deuteronomy 8:10: And you shall eat and be filled, and bless the Lord your God upon the good land which He has given you.
units.Deuteronomy 18:9: And when you enter the land which the Lord your God gives you, you shall not learn to do after the abominations of those nations.
units.Deuteronomy 18:10: There shall not be found among you one who purifies his son or his daughter by fire, or practises divination, or interprets spoken omens, or observes auguries, or works sorcery,
units.Deuteronomy 18:11: or chants spells, or is a medium, or observes portents, or inquires of the dead.
units.Deuteronomy 18:12: For everyone who does these things is an abomination unto the Lord your God; for because of these abominations the Lord shall destroy them from before you.
units.Deuteronomy 18:13: You shall be perfect before the Lord your God.
units.Deuteronomy 18:14: For these nations whose possession you inherit hearken unto omens and divinations; but the Lord your God has not granted you so to do.
units.Deuteronomy 18:15: The Lord your God shall raise up unto you a prophet from among your brethren, like unto me; you shall hearken unto him,
units.Deuteronomy 18:16: according to all that you asked of the Lord your God in Horeb, in the day of the assembly, saying: We will no more hear the voice of the Lord our God, neither will we see this great fire any more, lest we die.
units.Deuteronomy 18:17: And the Lord said unto me: All that they have spoken is right.
units.Deuteronomy 18:18: I will raise up for them a prophet from among their brethren, like unto you, and will put My word in his mouth; and he shall speak unto them all that I command him.
units.Deuteronomy 18:19: And the man who will not hearken unto whatsoever the prophet shall speak in My name, I will exact retribution from him.
units.Deuteronomy 18:20: But the prophet who shall act ungodly, speaking in My name a word which I commanded him not to speak, or who shall speak in the name of other gods, that prophet shall die.
units.Deuteronomy 18:21: And if you say in your heart: How shall we know the word which the Lord has not spoken?
units.Deuteronomy 18:22: Whatsoever the prophet speaks in the name of the Lord, if the word does not come to pass, nor is fulfilled, that is the word which the Lord has not spoken. That prophet has spoken in ungodliness; you shall not spare him.
units.Numbers 6:1: And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
units.Numbers 6:2: Speak unto the sons of Israel, and you shall say unto them: If a man or woman solemnly vows a vow of consecration unto the Lord, to be set apart
units.Numbers 6:3: from wine and strong drink, he shall be purified from wine. He shall drink neither vinegar of wine, nor vinegar of strong drink, nor anything prepared from grapes; and he shall eat neither fresh grapes nor raisins.
units.Numbers 6:4: All the days of his vow he shall consume nothing made from the vine: wine, from pressed grape skins unto the seed.
units.Numbers 6:5: All the days of the vow of purification no razor shall come upon his head. Until the days which he vowed unto the Lord are fulfilled, he shall be holy, letting the hair of his head grow long.
units.Numbers 6:6: All the days of his vow unto the Lord he shall not enter where any dead person is.
units.Numbers 6:7: For his father, or his mother, or his brother, or his sister, he shall not defile himself when they die; for the vow of his God is upon him, upon his head.
units.Numbers 6:8: All the days of his vow he shall be holy unto the Lord.
units.Isaiah 30:8: Now then, sit and write these things on a tablet and in a book, because these things will endure for days of appointed times and for ever.
units.Isaiah 30:9: For this is a disobedient people, lying sons who did not want to hear God’s law,
units.Isaiah 30:10: who say to the prophets, “Do not announce to us,” and to those seeing visions, “Do not speak to us. Instead, speak to us and announce another deception,
units.Isaiah 30:11: and turn us from this way, remove this path from us, and remove Israel’s Holy One from us.”
units.Psalms 32:13: From heaven the Lord looked down; He saw all the sons of men.
units.Psalms 32:14: From His prepared dwelling place He looked upon all who inhabit the earth.
units.Psalms 32:15: He formed their hearts individually; He understands all their deeds.
units.Psalms 32:16: A king is not saved through a great force, and a giant will not be saved by the abundance of his strength.
units.Psalms 32:17: A horse is false for salvation, and by the abundance of its power it will not be saved.
units.Psalms 32:18: Behold, the Lord’s eyes are upon those who fear Him, those who hope in His mercy,
units.Psalms 32:19: to rescue their souls from death and nourish them in famine.
units.Psalms 32:20: Our soul waits for the Lord, for He is our helper and defender.
units.Psalms 32:21: For our heart will rejoice in Him, and we have hoped in His holy name.
units.Psalms 32:22: May Thy mercy, Lord, be upon us, just as we have hoped in Thee.
units.Micah 6:1: Hear now the word of the Lord. The Lord said: “Rise, enter into judgment before the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice.”
units.Micah 6:2: Hear, hills, the Lord’s judgment, and you ravines, foundations of the earth! For the Lord has a case against His people, and He will argue it with Israel.
units.Micah 6:3: “My people, what have I done to you? How have I grieved you, or how have I troubled you? Answer Me!
units.Micah 6:4: For I brought you up from Egypt’s land and redeemed you from the house of slavery. I sent Moses, Aaron and Miriam before you.
units.Micah 6:5: My people, remember what Balak king of Moab planned against you and what Balaam son of Beor answered him, from the rushes to Galgal, so that the Lord’s righteousness may be known.”
units.Micah 6:6: With what shall I take hold of the Lord and grasp my God Most High? Shall I take hold of Him with whole burnt offerings, with year-old calves?
units.Micah 6:7: Will the Lord receive with thousands of rams or with ten thousands of fat-rich torrents? Shall I give my firstborn offspring for impieties, the fruit of my body for the sin of my life?
units.Micah 6:8: Has it been declared to you, O man, what is good? Or what does the Lord seek from you, except to do justice, and to love mercy, and to be ready to walk with the Lord your God?
units.Micah 6:9: The Lord’s voice will be called to the city, and He will save those who fear His name. “Hear, tribe! And who will adorn a city?
units.Micah 6:10: Is there not fire, and a lawless person’s house storing lawless treasures, and injustice with insolence?
units.Micah 6:11: Will a lawless person be justified with a balance and deceptive weights in a pouch?
units.Micah 6:12: From these they filled their wealth with impiety; those inhabiting her spoke falsehoods, and their tongue was exalted in their mouth.
units.Micah 6:13: And I will begin to strike you; I will obliterate you because of your sins.
units.Micah 6:14: You will eat but certainly not be filled. It will grow dark within you and turn aside, and you will certainly not be saved; whoever is saved will be handed over to the sword.
units.Micah 6:15: You will sow but certainly not reap; you will press olives but certainly not anoint yourself with oil, and you will press wine, but you shall certainly not drink it. The ordinances of My people will be obliterated.
units.Micah 6:16: You kept the ordinances of Zambri and all the works of Achaab’s house, and you walked in their counsels, so that I may hand you over to obliteration and her inhabitants to hissing. You will receive the reproaches of peoples.”
units.Deuteronomy 7:6: For you are a holy people unto the Lord your God; and the Lord your God has chosen you to be unto Him a people for His own possession, above all the nations upon the face of the earth.
units.Deuteronomy 7:7: The Lord preferred you and chose you, not because you were more numerous than all the nations, for you are the fewest of all the nations,
units.Deuteronomy 7:8: but because the Lord loved you, and kept the oath which He sware unto your fathers, the Lord brought you forth with a mighty hand and with an uplifted arm, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, out of the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
units.Deuteronomy 7:9: And you shall know that the Lord your God, He is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and mercy with them that love Him and keep His commandments, unto a thousand generations,
units.Deuteronomy 7:10: and repays them that hate Him to their face, to destroy them. He shall not delay with them that hate Him; He shall repay them to their face.
units.Deuteronomy 7:11: And you shall keep these commandments, and ordinances, and judgments, which I command you this day to do.
units.Isaiah 31:4: For thus the Lord said to me: “As a lion or lion cub cries over prey it has caught and shouts over it until the mountains fill with its voice, and they are defeated and terrified by the greatness of its wrath, so the Lord Sabaoth will descend to march upon Mount Zion, upon her mountains.
units.Isaiah 31:5: Like flying birds, so the Lord will shield Jerusalem, rescue, preserve and save.”
units.Ecclesiastes 9:11: Again I saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor battle to the mighty, nor bread to the wise, nor wealth to those with understanding, nor favor to those with knowledge; for time and encounter will happen to them all.
units.Ecclesiastes 9:12: For a person does not know his time: like fish caught in an evil net, and birds caught in a snare, so human beings are trapped at an evil time when it falls upon them suddenly.
units.Isaiah 45:5: For I am the Lord God, and there is no god besides Me, and you did not know Me,
units.Isaiah 45:6: so that those from the sun’s rising and those from its setting may know that there is none besides Me. I am the Lord God, and there is no other.
units.Isaiah 45:7: I fashioned light and made darkness; I make peace and create calamities. I am the Lord God, who does all these things.
units.Genesis 18:16: And the men rose from there and looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah; and Abraham went with them to escort them on their way.
units.Genesis 18:17: And the Lord said, “Shall I hide from Abraham My servant what I am doing?
units.Genesis 18:18: Abraham shall surely become a great and numerous nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him.

units.Ezekiel 26:3: therefore thus says the Lord: I am against you, Tyre, and I will bring many nations against you, as the sea rises with its waves.
units.Ezekiel 26:4: They will throw down Tyre’s walls and throw down your towers. I will winnow her dust from her and make her a smooth rock.
units.Ezekiel 26:5: She will be a drying place for nets in the midst of the sea, for I have spoken, says the Lord. She will become plunder for the nations,
units.Ezekiel 26:6: and her daughters in the plain will be killed by the sword. They will know that I am the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 26:7: For thus says the Lord: I am bringing against you, Tyre, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the north—he is king of kings—with horses, chariots, horsemen, and an assembly of very many nations.
units.Ezekiel 26:8: He will kill your daughters in the plain with the sword, set an advance guard against you, build around you, and make a palisade and a ring of weapons around you; he will set his spears opposite you.
units.Ezekiel 26:9: He will throw down your walls and your towers with his swords.
units.Ezekiel 26:10: The dust of his multitude of horses will cover you, and your walls will shake at the sound of his horsemen and his chariots’ wheels when he enters your gates like someone entering a city from the plain.
units.Ezekiel 26:11: With his horses’ hoofs they will trample all your squares. He will kill your people with the sword and bring the support of your strength down to the ground.
units.Ezekiel 26:12: He will plunder your strength, strip your possessions, throw down your walls, and demolish your desirable houses. He will throw your stones, timber, and dust into the sea.
units.Ezekiel 26:13: He will put an end to the multitude of your musicians, and the sound of your psalteries will certainly no longer be heard.
units.Ezekiel 26:14: I will make you a smooth rock, a drying place for nets. You will certainly not be rebuilt, for I have spoken, says the Lord.
